title: Precipitation Tank Agitator

introduction.definition: Precipitators are large tanks in which cooled, seeded pregnant liquor deposits gibbsite (aluminium hydroxide): NaAl(OH)₄ → Al(OH)₃ + NaOH. A slow draft-tube agitator circulates the slurry, keeping hydrate suspended with low shear so crystals grow and agglomerate.

temperature.title: Supersaturation drives precipitation
temperature.description: Cooled, seeded pregnant liquor is supersaturated: NaAl(OH)₄ → Al(OH)₃ + NaOH. Fine seed hydrate gives surface for growth and agglomeration. Precipitation runs for roughly 30–60 h through a train of tanks, cooling from about 75–80 °C to 60–65 °C (interstage cooling raises yield). The draft-tube agitator keeps the hydrate suspended with low shear.

foundation: Ring-wall or slab foundation designed for full liquid/slurry weight plus agitator dynamic loads; settlement monitoring for large tanks.
alignment: Tank plumb and level; agitator shaft vertical and concentric; check gearbox mounting.
piping: Nozzles sized for slurry velocity (avoid settling and erosion); flush connections; scaling-resistant design and descaling access.
Caustic service: suitable materials, gaskets and spray shields; eyewash/safety showers nearby.
commissioning: Water trials (agitator run with water, check vibration and power); then caustic/slurry; verify levels, interlocks and spillage containment (bunds).

periodic.task: Descale tank walls and draft tube.

lubrication: Agitator gearbox oil and motor bearings per maker; no lubrication for static parts.

safety: Hot caustic; confined space for descaling.

video_tutorials.title: Precipitation Tank Agitator — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Precipitation Tank Agitator.
Precipitators are large tanks in which cooled, seeded pregnant liquor deposits gibbsite (aluminium hydroxide): NaAl(OH)₄ → Al(OH)₃ + NaOH.
A slow draft-tube agitator circulates the slurry, keeping hydrate suspended with low shear so crystals grow and agglomerate.
Typical applications include gibbsite precipitation trains (often 10–20 tanks); agglomeration stage (fine seed, higher temperature); growth stage (coarse seed, interstage cooling).
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Precipitator: Agitator Shaft & Impeller.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Precipitation Tank Agitator — Operation

script.narration: How the Precipitation Tank Agitator works.
Pregnant liquor and seed enter.
The impeller pushes slurry down the draft tube.
Slurry rises in the annulus and circulates.
Crystals grow as alumina precipitates.
Interstage cooling raises yield.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Cooled, seeded pregnant liquor is supersaturated: NaAl(OH)₄ → Al(OH)₃ + NaOH.

video_tutorials.title: Precipitation Tank Agitator — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Precipitation Tank Agitator.
Monitor temperature profile and solids.
Descale tank walls and draft tube.
Agitator gearbox overhaul.
Watch for scale build-up: loss of volume. Common cause: hydrate scale.
Watch for fine product: weak, fine hydrate. Common cause: oxalate, too much nucleation.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
